AC-0429 — the skybox must have no bottom edge (the planet is the horizon)

Verdict. The user's correction to AC-0428, in their own words: "the sky box can't have a bottom edge, we are in space! We can't fake the horizon, the planet and satellite is the horizon." AC-0428 removed the STEP at the local horizon by BLENDING the gradient's anchor to the air colour — the right result, the wrong shape: it kept the lower boundary as a CONCEPT (the anchor, the band, the u_air floor below it). This ticket removes the concept: five separate things in sky_on() implied a lower boundary (below-branch air floor, horizon anchor, branch-switch band, horizon haze band, thinning horizon-exemption) and the fix blends the floor, the anchor and the band to SPACE with one derived weight ws = smoothstep(0, 0.3, w), leaving the planet's limb (its disc, its u_air rim, the limb air-column glow) as the only boundary. Shipped behind a new switch no_sky_floor (DEFAULT ON — the user asked) + AWECRAFT_NOSKYFLOOR=0|1 + menu row; OFF is bit-for-bit the pre-AC-0429 path (mix(x, y, 0.0) = x), and sky_off is untouched (the sky's off state stays byte-identical). All light gates green; the user's frame re-taken: below the local horizon the row-median profile is now flat space (spread 0.00) with stars, was a flat pale air floor at 247+; the only step in the after frame is the planet's limb.

Render caveat: frames are lavapipe Vulkan (the SHIPPED Forward+ path), 1280×720, R50 (AWECRAFT_RADIUS=50), the planet/orbit camera, T=0.5, seed 44, drain 60, no AWECRAFT_LOGIC. Renders on this box are a proxy (software GL) — geometry/layout/colour evidence only, not the user's Windows look. The display pipeline is not plain sRGB (the AC-0428 3-point calibration: slopes 0.83 low / 0.45 high); the instrument reports 255-scale display values, and the acceptance numbers below are relative (before vs after on the SAME pipeline), so the proxy caveat applies to absolute colour, not to the flatness/spread/step claims.

What was found drawing or implying a lower boundary — five things

#Thing (all in sky_on(), aero_sky_gradient.gdshader)What it drew
1below-branch air floor belowc = mix(mix(space, u_air, 1−w), u_air, u_horizon) — AC-0417's below-cone branch, AC-0422 made it u_air at every altitudethe flat pale u_air band below hl=0 — the skybox's bottom face (the main body of the defect)
2gradient horizon anchor horizon_eff = mix(horizon_color, u_air, w·u_horizon) (AC-0428)the upper gradient's lower edge anchored to the air colour — AC-0428's "step 0.00" made the two box halves the SAME COLOUR, the boundary-as-structure remained
3branch-switch band smoothstep(0, 0.03, −hl) (AC-0422)a ~2° blend band straddling the local horizon — the soft edge of the box's lower face
4horizon haze band exp(−|hl|·9)·haze_amount·(1−w)a bright band centred ON the local horizon — the "air seen edge-on" of the floor (20% weight at the user's w=0.8)
5thinning horizon-exemption thin = w·u (AC-0428)the local horizon is where the sky darkens LAST — the lower edge of the space transition (the rate itself is CORRECT and untouched — it is the A-window contract, not a boundary)

NOT a lower boundary (deliberately untouched): the limb term (the planet's own air — it becomes the ONLY boundary), the star field (full sphere, no bottom face), AeroWash (uniform), satellite body + cloud shells (the planet + its air), env fog / the fog wall (terrain), sky_off (the sky's OFF state — byte-identical), under_disc (w≡0 there, provably a no-op).

The fix (one derived weight, one uniform, switch-gated)

uniform float u_no_floor : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.0;   // 0.0 = pre-AC-0429 path verbatim

// sky_on() only, after "float w = u_space_sky;":
float ws = smoothstep(0.0, 0.3, w);                      // the FLOOR's space weight (0 at ground, 1 from alt ~630 m; derived from w — AC-0417 one-number principle)

vec3 horizon_eff = mix(horizon_color, u_air, w * u_horizon);                       // AC-0428, kept
vec3 anchor  = mix(horizon_eff, mix(horizon_color, space_color, ws), u_no_floor);  // (2) anchor -> space
vec3 grad    = mix(anchor, mid_color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.30, u));

float thin = mix(mix(w * w, w, u) * 1.0, w * u, u_horizon);                        // UNTOUCHED — the AC-0428 uniform rate
vec3 above  = mix(grad, space_color, thin);

vec3 belowc = mix(mix(space_color, u_air, 1.0 - w), u_air, u_horizon);             // AC-0422/AC-0417, kept
belowc = mix(belowc, mix(u_air, space_color, ws), u_no_floor);                     // (1) floor -> space

float hz = exp(-abs(hl) * 9.0) * haze_amount * (1.0 - w) * mix(1.0, 1.0 - ws, u_no_floor);   // (4) band dies with the floor

Why no line and no band result: (3) needs no change — with both branch colours space-anchored, the 2° switch band blends space into space (a no-op in the limit; at w<0.3 it blends air into air, exactly as pre-ticket). The colour at hl=0 stays CONTINUOUS for every w: above(0) = below(0−) = the same mix; |residual seam| = |horizon − u_air|·(1−ws) — the pre-existing ground-level seam order, 0 from ws=1. At w=0 (ground) ws=0 and every mix returns the pre-ticket value even with the switch ON (the ground daytime sky and the AC-0384 r8 fog seam are bit-for-bit). u_no_floor = 0 keeps everything verbatim (IEEE mix(x, y, 0.0) = x). u_air survives ONLY at w=0: the world's fog fades to u_air and the body's rim IS u_air, so the sky beyond must be the same — at altitude that seam no longer exists because the floor is space.

Acceptance 1 — the user's frame re-taken (horizon aim, 800 m, w = 0.799)

BEFORE (switch OFF = the pre-ticket AC-0428 look): the lower half is a flat pale air floor (247+ everywhere) — the skybox's bottom face; the stars are buried in it. AFTER (switch ON, the shipped default): the sky fades smoothly into BLACK SPACE with stars; the local horizon (frame centre) is invisible; the only thing in the lower frame is the planet and its air.

Switch + surfaces

  • Settings no_sky_floor — DEFAULT ON (the user asked), sanitize_bool clamp.
  • Env AWECRAFT_NOSKYFLOOR=0|1 — boot-only preload WITHOUT save (the AC-0426/AC-0428 pattern).
  • Menu — Settings-page row "Sky: space below the horizon (the planet is the horizon)" (slot hi+20, after the cloud-gate row), live via _ac0401_push (change-gated on _ac0429_nofloor) — no apply step owed.
  • Shader — u_no_floor on the sky material (default 0.0 = pre-AC-0429 path).
  • Docs — ARCHITECTURE.md (Settings row + sky-pass §3 note), HARNESS.md §2 env row.

Deliberately NOT done

  • No change to the thinning rate, the limb term, the body, the clouds, the fog, or sky_off — the boundary is removed, not redistributed.
  • No new altitude constant — ws derives from w (the A window; AC-0417 one-number principle).
  • No hand edit of TASKS.yaml (status flip is the coordinator's at closeout); no commit/push (fenced tree with another session's uncommitted work); fenced files (main.gd / game.gd / drop.gd / debug.gd) untouched.
  • The physical "air seen edge-on at the local horizon" brightness is removed WITH the floor (it was the floor's band, item 4) — the atmosphere that remains is the planet's own limb air, which is the horizon the user asked for.
